title: Loto learning hub: restore real result sync, autopilot generation and learner stats (Go pipeline was stubbed; prod has 0 draws)

spec.problem: kiokoto.com /magazine/loto is empty: prod returns totalDraws=0, nextDraw=null, feed=[]. The Go port stubbed the legacy NestJS pipeline: admin sync only writes an audit row, autopilot/catchup crons are TODO no-ops, generate emits placeholder sequences, next-draw returns drawNumber/vocab/confidence as null, stats exposes only counts.

acceptance.text: AC1: loto.ParseCSV decodes the Shift_JIS thekyo CSV (loto6 and loto7 headers, 2000/10/5 style dates) into validated draws and rejects out-of-range, duplicate or wrong-count rows naming the row

AC2: loto.Generate is deterministic for a seed, returns N unique sorted sets inside 1..max that satisfy the shape filter, honours pinned/excluded numbers, ignores weight keys it does not model, and falls back to a seeded uniform choice when fewer than 10 official draws exist
AC3: loto.NextScheduledDrawDate and ResolveAutopilotTarget use the JST calendar (loto6 Mon/Thu, loto7 Fri) and report waiting_result when the next draw is not in the future

AC4: loto.Service.RunAutopilot imports new draws, then creates exactly one published run per game+target date (autopilot_key), republishes a half-done run, returns already_done on repeats, and backfills a labelled backtest history

AC5: GET /api/magazine/loto/next-draw returns drawNumber, confidence, vocabItems, schedule fields and a JST daysUntil; GET /api/magazine/loto/feed lists published predictions (and backtests) with the matched official result, hitCount, bonusHit and jpSentence

AC6: GET /api/magazine/loto/stats returns per-number frequency, hot/cold/overdue lists, parity and sum distributions, recent official results and prediction accuracy versus the random-baseline expectation, keeping the existing totalDraws/latestDraw/earliestDraw fields
AC7: admin sync, autopilot and generate endpoints run the real service instead of audit-only or placeholder behaviour, and the loto6/loto7/catchup cron jobs plus a startup catch-up call the service
AC8: the web hub renders a statistics lab tab and official results strip from /stats with vi/en/ja labels, and the hero shows the draw number, confidence hint, schedule and vocab from next-draw

spec.expected_behavior: Result data is synced from the allowlisted CSV source on a schedule and at startup; each upcoming draw gets exactly one idempotent seeded prediction run published with a Japanese learning sentence and vocab; the learner hub shows next draw, history with hit/miss and official results, plus a statistics lab (frequency, hot/cold/overdue, parity, accuracy vs random baseline).
spec.observed_behavior: Empty feed, no hero card, stats with only counts, cron jobs log 'stub' and do nothing, admin Generate creates 1,8,15.. style placeholder sets.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the commit; the cron jobs return to no-ops. No schema migration is added, imported draws and generated runs remain valid rows.
